doc.name: G — 30s charity impact story set in a megacity night, wry in tone, a mascot character, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: charity impact story set in a megacity night, wry in tone
Hero: a mascot character
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the charity impact story set in a megacity night, wry in tone form, built around a mascot character.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Any on-screen text must use the same wording and placement logic in every act.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a slow push with a simultaneous barely-perceptible dutch roll in Act 1 against a parallax slide with strong foreground/background separation in Act 3 — while holding the high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second charity impact story set in a megacity night, wry in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mascot character.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a slow push with a simultaneous barely-perceptible dutch roll, shot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/4, framed with a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill; grade as warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second charity impact story set in a megacity night, wry in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mascot character.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a crane-up that starts at knee height and finishes above eye line, shot on a 40mm anamorphic at f/1.4, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce; grade as a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second charity impact story set in a megacity night, wry in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mascot character.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a parallax slide with strong foreground/background separation, shot on a 50mm anamorphic with 2x squeeze at f/2, framed with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down; grade as a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.negative_prompt: blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows
